cause: Channels 32 and 33 are configured as masked physical pins, but AutoDQM appears to evaluate them as normally active channels; this likely produces repeated missing-channel alerts and abnormal low-statistics pulse/occupancy features. Whether the masking itself is intentional is unknown.
action: Verify that physical pins/channels 32 and 33 are intentionally masked and compare the mask active in each subrun with the static snapshot. If intentional, exclude masked channels from missing-channel and occupancy-based anomaly checks. If unintended, restore the correct mask configuration and start a validation run. If channel 32 remains anomalous when enabled, inspect its digitizer input and compare channels 32/33 waveforms, rates, and board matching before considering cable or hardware intervention.

LVDS telemetry shows no persistently missing, zero, low, or high pin, arguing against a clear persistent LVDS failure. INFERRED: mask-aware monitoring or configuration inconsistency is more plausible than established digitizer lockup or LVDS noise. UNKNOWN: per-subrun mask changes, board matching, digitizer rates, synchronization, and whether the mask was intentional. No exact historical match exists; runs 2068 and 2126 provide only partial missing-channel/LVDS analogies.
